notes: Every surface whose native port is under the visual gate (#874, ADR-0118). A surface appears here before it is switched on, and docs/mobile/screens.json may only set "enabled": true when this file carries its evidence. Each entry names the web route, the contract (shared/visual/<surface>.json - the elements and properties both clients must agree on), the test that draws the app side, and the tolerances: pixels is the share of the capture allowed to differ, length the CSS-pixel drift allowed on a box. Evidence lives in e2e/__visual__/<surface>/ and is recorded by `npm run visual:capture` (page) and the app's own visual test (screen). Nothing is switched on yet: every port is off until its pair passes.
